purpose: Teach: 万事/仕業/犯さ/家宅/別居/高等裁判所/徴税/性教育

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、万事に注意して警察、対応されてますね
lines.en: So the police are being careful with all the details of this case, aren't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, tentative tone. Leaning forward slightly with genuine curiosity. Acknowledging expertise without presuming. Patient pause after the question mark — waiting for the answer, not rushing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不審な仕業を見逃さないよう警戒します
lines.en: The police will stay alert to make sure we don't miss any suspicious activity.
lines.style: Measured, professional delivery. Steady eye contact. Each phrase placed with quiet precision. No performance — just the assurance of procedure being followed correctly. Slight firmness on 'alert.'

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者が人権を犯さないか警察、注視されてますね
lines.en: And I imagine the police are keeping a close watch to ensure the suspect's rights aren't being violated?
lines.style: Careful, almost deferential phrasing. Slight hesitation — checking himself for whether the question is appropriate. Genuine concern underneath the formal language. Soft on the trailing clause.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、家宅捜索の手続きを厳密に進めます
lines.en: We're conducting the home search with strict procedural compliance at every step.
lines.style: Precise, formal register. Each word weighted and deliberate. No rushedness. A hint of respect in the delivery — this matters and it's being done right. Steady throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の別居生活を警察、把握されてますね
lines.en: I also imagine the police have established where the suspect has been living separately?
lines.style: Genuinely inquisitive, not challenging. Mild surprise that this detail matters. Building on the previous question with the same thoughtful hesitation. Open, waiting posture in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、高等裁判所への送致準備を進めます
lines.en: We're preparing the case file for transfer to the high court.
lines.style: Objective, procedural tone. No elaboration, no warmth — just the next step being stated clearly. Professional finality. Slightly formal register shift from the previous lines.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、徴税逃れの捜査も警察、なさるんですね
lines.en: And the police will also be investigating the tax evasion angle, I take it?
lines.style: Careful intellectual curiosity. Connecting disparate threads. Not doubting — asking to understand the scope. Slight tilt of recognition on 'also.' Genuinely processing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、子供の安全のため性教育の啓発を支援します
lines.en: The police also support outreach programs on safety and education for children affected by cases like this.
lines.style: Warmer shift. Genuine care underneath the procedural language. A moment of human priority breaking through the formal framework. Quieter, more personal than the earlier lines. Steady but with quiet conviction.
